toolsPreview.name: ping
toolsPreview.description: Connectivity check — returns server version and current timestamp. Use to verify MCP server is reachable before calling other tools.

toolsPreview.name: get_company_profile
toolsPreview.description: Returns 나라투어 core metadata — address, hours, specialties, contact channels. Use when the user asks about 나라투어 identity, location, or how to contact.

toolsPreview.name: get_kakao_consult_link
